invariants.rule: Public results are source-linked and scoped. No invented data, timing-phase substitution, hidden selection of only winning points, or historical summary presented as a new run. Existing GPU resource control remains required.

Documentation-first, at most one coherent mechanical source cluster by default. Preserve numerical/scientific semantics, live ownership, generated authority state and immutable evidence. Final source paths and status must be checked after intervening packages.

A biology-purpose learning operation needs an explicit model assumption, semantic contract, exact reference and identified computational advantage to test. Biological labels or a generic ML kernel alone do not establish this. Model restrictions are hypotheses, not truths or hardware requirements.

Preserve actual measurement relationships and allowed information. Population snapshots and sibling cells are not individual trajectories; nominal common forcing is not identical intracellular input. No held-out ATAC, future targets or target-derived preprocessing in unauthorized inference.

Separate engineering correctness, scientific adequacy, numerical policy and performance. Searched candidates are not an exhaustive compatible set; no fabricated biology, derivative support, compiler coverage or speedup.

Keep biological/structure identity independent of physical layout and encoding. Preserve ordered and repeated arguments, actual saved-primal generations, lawful contribution assembly and canonical parameter ownership. Never hide mutation inside the new composable backward.

Use coarse outcomes and evidence-selected alternatives. Reuse ordinary Torch and existing Cellerator compositions before new kernels. Easy work may proceed immediately. A costly design needs an explicit rationale, not a universal framework or mandatory survey.

GlassHelix owns scientific models, evidence and inference meaning; Torch supplies ordinary ML. CelleraTorch owns framework integration; native Cellerator owns reusable biological math, differentiation, parameter/value contracts, geometry, planning and compiler/runtime. No parallel GH ML runtime or CT kernel home.

Preserve successful NF1A, compiler, relation, geometry and CelleraTorch work and separate Todo authorities. No retirement, runtime replacement, old-plan reapply, unrelated cleanup, preprint edits or Ampere-epic activation is authorized.

This is a prototype campaign. Label equivalent lowering, new model family and approximation separately. Small correctness/gradient checks suffice for prototype acceptance; no invented speedup, scientific identification or exhaustive qualification requirement.

Cellerator owns native mathematics, physical representations, compilation and execution; CelleraTorch owns framework integration; GlassHelix owns models, evidence, interpretation and authorized refactorings. Keep separate Todo authorities.

Keep successful ML2-TRAIN, NF1A, existing compiler/runtime and sibling consumers. Never hand-edit Todo storage/generated views. Do not activate Ampere or edit preprints. Reconcile claims and frozen interfaces before source integration or selective supersession.

Preserve logical identity, local coordinate meaning, single-snapshot reads, ordered/repeated arguments, contribution ownership and saved-primal generations. Numerical zero is not absent derivative support. No hidden optimizer update in backward.
Two independent additive schema-3 imports. Never write SQLite/generated authority directly. Import may create active run metadata but never dispatches through package scripts.

After controller launch, complete the accepted program autonomously using first-class project-qualified claims; revise scopes/contracts through authority when necessary, without repeated ordinary-choice confirmation.
Mechanisms admit true n-ary nonlinear dependence and role-ordered arguments; pairwise execution specializations do not constrain scientific ontology.
Cross-project work is gated by source/interface/test receipts and fresh authoritative producer completion. No fictitious foreign native dependency or cross-project parent lane.
Derivative capabilities are optional and explicit. Missing derivative is not zero. Preserve primal generations and distinct primal/parameter-response support.
No mock, syntax-only program, skipped/missing test, header declaration or CPU fallback satisfies real native/GPU acceptance.
Domain/order/structure/epoch/value identity is explicit. Scientific mechanism identity is not a kernel boundary; stable ids do not establish biological identifiability.
Independent mutable bindings over shared structure; complete preflight; readiness differs from submission; stale and poisoned state cannot publish valid results.
Real f32 path and independent f64 oracle; qualify precision, pruning, fusion and error. Local null diagnostics are not global identifiability claims.
Dynamical state, observations and inferential state are distinct. Missing values and zeros differ. Population snapshots are not fabricated individual trajectories.
GlassHelix owns scientific roles/composition/interpretation; Cellerator owns reusable numerical and execution machinery. Improve current owners instead of duplicating engines.
Whole-lifetime cost governs promotion. Preserve correct alternatives and negative results. One real GPU lease plus shared host lock across both authorities.
Preserve unrelated dirty work, branches, runs, pending patches and consumers. No reset/clean/force rewrite or CE-AMP activation. Clean only owned verified-merged worktrees.
Execution toolbox only; no biological experiment, final learner, full compiler/JIT, distributed engine or sequence inference is implicitly activated.

The root chooses decomposition, ordinary APIs, tests, algorithms, scope transfers and delegation. Explain consequential choices; do not generate procedural microtasks or request routine user direction.

Use the existing numerical, identity, preparation and lifetime owners. Project-local claims govern writes; source scopes are coordination boundaries, amendable with conflict checks, not reasons to duplicate implementation.
Preserve unknown/uncommitted/unmerged work, all successful legacy records and unrelated programs. Selective evidence-backed pruning is allowed; mass deletion, reset/clean and force-push are not.
Deliver the accepted supplied-system execution toolbox, not a biological experiment, new learner, universal identifiability theorem or new execution framework.

Real capabilities require source-bound executed evidence. A descriptor, reference-only oracle, fake provider, skipped test, enqueue counter or unselected optimization does not establish a native capability.
Keep GlassHelix, Cellerator, CellShard, and Baseplane ownership distinct as recorded in the authoritative project identity.
Preserve unknown, uncommitted, divergent, historical, and experimental work unless its disposition is explicitly established.
Treat foundational scientific questions as open; do not convert them into a model, API, package, CUDA, serialization, dataset, or roadmap commitment.
